About the job
Company Description

Eluvio is revolutionizing premium video management and distribution with its breakthrough technology, the Eluvio Content Fabric. This global platform offers low-latency content delivery, monetization, and asset servicing directly to consumers without the need for traditional content delivery networks (CDNs) or file duplication. With built-in blockchain technology, it ensures secure rights control, monetization, and media personalization across devices. Trusted by major players in Hollywood and mobile streaming, the Eluvio Content Fabric has received multiple accolades, including the Best of Show at NAB 2026 for its inline Video AI, Product of the Year, and 2020 Engineering Excellence Award by the Hollywood Professional Association. Founded by pioneers in content-centric design, ML, and blockchain, Eluvio continues to lead innovation in the media and technology space.



Role Description

The AI-Machine Learning Summer Internship at Eluvio is a full-time, on-site role located in Berkeley, CA. As an intern, you will work on cutting-edge projects involving machine learning and deep learning to enhance Eluvio’s Content Fabric technology. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include testing, and helping in developing and optimizing algorithms within our inline multi-modal AI stack for video, working closely with experts in our core AI team. This hands-on role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of video technology in a dynamic and innovative environment.



Qualifications

Strong foundation in Computer Science, including familiarity with programming languages and data structures
Proficiency in Machine Learning and Deep Learning concepts, techniques, and frameworks
Understanding of Statistics and experience in applying statistical models to analyze data
Experience with Algorithms and problem-solving, particularly in large-scale data or multimedia contexts
Self-motivated with strong analytical and critical thinking skills
Effective communication and collaboration abilities within a team environment
Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD student in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field
Familiarity with blockchain technology and video processing is a plus
